wrongSide.title: Kesilapan Biasa
wrongSide.body: Using 'would' for past states, e.g. 'Years ago, there would be a creepy well behind our school.'

rightSide.title: Jawapan Tepat
rightSide.body: 'Be' describes a state, not a repeated action, so use 'used to': 'There used to be a creepy well...'.
